gpt.rationale: The sprites stay mostly subdued and inward—embarrassed, anxious, shy, quiet determination—fitting an introvert, with only minor bluntness like repeated embarrassed/anxious labels where confusion or relief might fit better.

claude.rationale: Every sprite choice reflects Aoi's introverted, emotionally restrained personality—embarrassment and anxiety dominate her external expression even during high-stakes moments, with only subtle shifts (shy wonder, determined resolve) breaking through, and the final surprised-to-embarrassed arc perfectly captures how an introvert processes extraordinary experience with quiet, internal processing.
